# Public identity vectors

`identity-vectors.json` is an unchanged copy of the public hub candidate at
`iokaio/munarium-platform`, revision `eaa33e8dfafc53f2874fecaa5b62e69208d45793`,
path `docs/decisions/candidates/identity-vectors.json` (Apache-2.0).

LF-normalized SHA-256: `a60f52749ad657fea82abdddc79955b235946391bb1a7a76373a705bba111c2d`.
The test checks this pin and preserves every expected outcome. The runtime's narrower
non-human profile explicitly refuses the positive human-bootstrap case. These are
proposed vectors, not a released or accepted contract. No signing keys are copied.
